    Corollary 2.11: Γ_{A₀} ≅ Γ_A #

    graded-category.tex (cor:same-ar-quiver): "The Auslander–Reiten quivers of A₀ and A are isomorphic as translation quivers."

    The evaluated modules M_x form a skeleton of ind(mod A₀) (skelA0): they are indecomposable, pairwise nonisomorphic (evA_iso_eq), and every finite-dimensional indecomposable A₀-module is one of them (evA_complete, from Proposition 2.10).
